name: VoidkitUtility
description:
Server maintenance.

  clearlag  sweeps piled-up dropped items into a trash bin players can retrieve from
  perf      TPS / MSPT sampling, chunk entity hotspot ranking, optional gentle intervention

This module matters most on large modpacks: once entity counts climb, unpicked item drops keep eating tick budget.

Every parameter is configurable and the defaults are deliberately conservative - the perf module observes but does not touch the world unless you ask it to.

Each module can be toggled individually via the `features` config.
Requires voidkit_core. Server-side only.
